purpose: Recover the frozen full-vocabulary head's token choices with a low-rank all-vocabulary retrieval stage followed by exact int8 reranking of only a bounded shortlist, byte fallback, EOS, and current prompt IDs.

measured_trigger.finding: Static or calibrated candidate reserves change the argmax trajectory. Candidate-set expansion adds per-token cost without restoring the parent token sequence.

architecture.exact_weight_source: The existing 50,257 by 768 signed-int8 tied input embedding and its per-row scales.
architecture.retrieval_factorization: Deterministic uncentered randomized SVD of the dequantized tied embedding, seed 9824, five power iterations.
architecture.retrieval_execution: Project the current 768-dimensional output state into the locked rank, score every vocabulary ID in that low-rank space, and select TopK.
architecture.exact_rerank: Union TopK with all 256 byte-fallback IDs, EOS, and exact token IDs in the current prompt; gather the original int8 embedding rows and original row scales; run the unchanged exact MatMulInteger output path.
architecture.runtime_mapping: The graph returns the authoritative global candidate IDs used for each step. Repetition and no-repeat controls apply to every occurrence if candidate IDs are duplicated.

train_only_trace_screen.trajectory: Replay the frozen full-vocabulary LayerCake host's authoritative generated IDs and inspect output states in memory only.
train_only_trace_screen.metric: Fraction of repetition-controlled full-head selected token IDs contained in the approximate TopK union locked byte/EOS/prompt IDs.

execution_and_stop_rule.trace_requirement: Do not build a configuration with train-trace selected-token recall below 0.99 unless every smaller configuration also fails and it is the final locked endpoint.
runtime_pass: median throughput ratio to Qwen at least 2.0
paired-prompt bootstrap 95 percent lower bound at least 2.0
at least 95 percent sealed Phase 2 parent median throughput
all TTFT, RSS, active-memory, persistent-state, UTF-8, and collapse gates pass
execution_and_stop_rule.after_runtime_pass: Run all 1,400 ABI validation rows, all 420/43,089 general-English validation rows, the 120-observation headline benchmark, physical proof, identity, and adversarial tests on that exact graph.
execution_and_stop_rule.early_stop: Stop at the first configuration passing the trace screen and every runtime and quality gate.
execution_and_stop_rule.failure: If rank128_top256 fails, close adaptive low-rank shortlisting and preserve all factors, traces, artifacts, and negative evidence before authorizing a different architecture.

claim_boundary: Approximate retrieval is never called lossless. Only exact reranking uses original output rows. Promotion requires the same final host to satisfy the bounded semantic suite and exact package/ABI identity gates.
